visible_text: Applied Intelligence Services | Audio Jones Audio Jones Services Applied Intelligence Services We don't sell tools. We build the systems your tools should have been part of from day one. Calculate Your AI ROI Apply for Engagement We engage selectively. Most buildouts ship in 60 to 90 days. Diagnostic first, automation second, measurement always. The Method We diagnose your operating system, then install what is missing. Founder-led businesses rarely need more isolated software. They need the connective tissue between the tools they already use, the workflows their team repeats, and the decisions that move revenue. We treat AI as a force multiplier on a working system , not a substitute for one. Every engagement starts by finding the constraint, then builds only the automation and measurement layer required to remove it. Engagements How we work with founder-led businesses. Four static engagement paths replace the old catalog model. Each path is scoped around operational leverage, not product browsing or off-the-shelf packages. Diagnostic AI Business Systems Diagnostic A focused review of the operating system your business already runs on: intake, follow-up, fulfillment, content, reporting, and decision cadence. We identify the bottlenecks, quantify the upside, and define where AI belongs before anything is built. 2 weeks · founder + ops lead · readiness map Buildout Applied Intelligence Systems Buildout The core engagement for installing the workflows your team should have had from day one. We turn the diagnostic into connected intake, automation, agent, and reporting layers that reduce manual drag without burying the operator in another tool stack. 60–90 days · system sprints · measured rollout Workflow AI Agent Workflow Design Modular tactical work for teams that already know the workflow they need to upgrade. We design the agent responsibilities, handoff points, prompts, guardrails, and escalation paths so automation supports the human operator instead of replacing judgment. 1–2 sprints · SOPs + agents · adoption support Measurement Attribution + Signal Audit A measurement-layer audit for founders who cannot see which campaigns, conversations, or systems are producing real pipeline. We clean up the signal path from source to close so future automation has a trustworthy scoreboard. 2–4 weeks · attribution map · signal scorecard Process Diagnostic first. Automation second. Measurement always. The list is the diagram: understand the system, pick the leverage point, install the layer, then prove the work changed the operating rhythm. Read the full Applied Intelligence framework → 01 Map the operating system We document how work actually moves through the business: where requests enter, who touches them, which tools carry state, and where decisions stall. 02 Prioritize leverage We separate high-signal constraints from noisy tool problems, then choose the workflows where applied intelligence can measurably improve speed, clarity, or conversion. 03 Build the system layer We install the automation, agent, and reporting layer around your existing stack so the team gets a working operating rhythm, not another disconnected dashboard. 04 Measure and harden We instrument adoption, cycle time, and business signal, then tighten the workflows until the system becomes durable enough to run without constant founder intervention. Signal What working with us looks like in practice. The work is intentionally narrow: fewer catalog choices, clearer operating leverage, and a measurement loop that tells the founder whether the system is paying back. 60–90 days is the typical window for a focused systems buildout once the diagnostic is complete. 4 engagement paths cover diagnostic, buildout, workflow design, and attribution clarity. 1 operating system view keeps tools, agents, data, and human handoffs aligned. Read Applied Intelligence insights → Review operator case studies → Ready to engage Start with a diagnostic. Most engagements begin there. If your tools are creating work instead of reducing it, the diagnostic gives us the operating-system map before we recommend a buildout.
